method.execution: signal at close, fill at next open; fee/slippage haircuts on each side
method.ohlcv_stop_assumption: if stop and target hit within same hourly bar, assume stop first
limitations: historical OHLCV cannot reconstruct actual spread, order-book depth, exchange filters, exact fill fees, or 60-second trailing-stop path
rolling risk halts and three-loss halt are approximated at hourly close
strategy-only no-halt scenarios are diagnostic and are not deployed risk behavior
this is a research backtest, not evidence of future profitability
